meaning: The enclave's Ed25519 signing key, the key its attestation record names.
The enclave's X25519 encryption key. Grants and call inputs are encrypted to it.
The wallet that registered the enclave. It receives the operator share.
The enclave's `http://` or `https://` address, up to 256 bytes.
The address of the enclave's attestation record.
0 `dev`, 1 Intel TDX, 2 AMD SEV-SNP, as the record states.
The slot the record was written in, as of the last register or refresh.
The slot the record expires at, as of the last register or refresh.
How many calls the enclave has settled.
